title: Affine extension and sections respect the adjunction unit
statement: Let $g:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ be a morphism of affine schemes, and let $Q\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}R})$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-derived-category]. Put $\Gamma_R=R\Gamma_{\mathrm{id}_R}$ and $\Gamma_B=R\Gamma_{\mathrm{id}_B}$ with their fixed affine restrictions [def-pc-affine-global-hom-base-change-map]. Suppose $v:g_*;\Gamma_{\mathrm{id}_R}\cong\Gamma_{\mathrm{id}_B};\rho$ is identity on sections and $r:Rg_*;\Gamma_R\cong\Gamma_B;D\rho$ satisfies its right-derived-unit normalization, exactly as in lean.statement. Here $\rho$ restricts along the canonical R-to-B map. There is an isomorphism $a:\mathrm{Ext}_g(\Gamma_R Q)\cong\Gamma_B(Lg^*Q)$ such that $\eta_{\mathrm{Ext}}(\Gamma_R Q);D\rho(a)=\Gamma_R(\eta_g(Q));r_{Lg^*Q}$ for the fixed affine extension/restriction and canonical pullback/direct-image adjunctions [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image, def-pc-affine-global-hom-base-change-map]. No flatness, Tor independence or perfectness is assumed.

proof.text: Represent Q by Q(tilde M) with M K-flat, using the proved affine module-complex model theorem.

Define n(K) as the transpose of Gamma_R(unit_g(K)) followed by r at Lg*K. Adjunction naturality, naturality of the pullback unit, and naturality of r show n(K);Gamma_B(Lg*f)=Ext(Gamma_R(f));n(Kprime).

The model-mate theorem makes n invertible at Q(tilde M). Apply the naturality square to the model isomorphism Q to Q(tilde M). All other sides are functorial images of isomorphisms, so cancel the right side to obtain invertibility of n(Q).
Take a=asIso(n(Q)). The apply_symm_apply equation of the extension/restriction Hom equivalence gives exactly the displayed unit equation.

theorem exists_affineExtensionSectionsUnit
    {R B : CommRingCat.{u}} (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec R)
    (v : RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom ⋙
        affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R)) ≅
      affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B)) ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g))
    (r : schemeDerivedDirectImage g ⋙ affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R)) ≅
      affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B)) ⋙
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g)).mapDerivedCategory)
    (hv : ∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec B).toRingedSpace))
        (x : (affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B))).obj M), (v.hom.app M) x = x)
    (hr : ∀ J : HomotopyCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec B).toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ),
      (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompUnit
          (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom)
          (affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R)))).app J ≫
        (affineGlobalSectionsDerivedIso (𝟙 (Spec R))).hom.app
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage g).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj J)) ≫
        r.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj J) =
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((v.hom.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).app J) ≫
        (affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B)) ⋙
          ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g)).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app J ≫
        (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso
            (affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B)))
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g)) ≪≫
          Functor.isoWhiskerRight (affineGlobalSectionsDerivedIso (𝟙 (Spec B)))
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g)).mapDerivedCategory).hom.app
          (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj J))
    (Q : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec R)) (hQ : schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec R) Q) :
    ∃ a : (affineDerivedExtension g).obj
        ((affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R))).obj Q) ≅
      (affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec B))).obj ((derivedPullback g).obj Q),
      (affineDerivedExtensionAdjunction g).unit.app
          ((affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R))).obj Q) ≫
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g)).mapDerivedCategory.map a.hom =
      (affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R))).map
          ((canonicalPullbackAdjunction g).unit.app Q) ≫
        r.hom.app ((derivedPullback g).obj Q)
